scope: Whole UI5 versus UI6 card/shop scene cost measured as unpaced host steady-clock intervals through production ranged FILE resource callbacks. These intervals are not process CPU time, displayed FPS, emulator speed, or physical-calculator timing.

method.order: ENG AB/BA/AB; ZHS BA/AB/BA, sequential interleaving by round
method.warm_statistic: Median of three per-run 180-frame mean intervals; all per-run means, maxima and source counters are retained below.
method.cold_statistic: Median of three first complete-frame observation intervals. Hover cold includes both the inventory-opening frame and the first hit-targeted hover frame.
method.idle_pointer_assertion: After the closed-room frame and the inventory-opening frame, hit_at must have no enabled target in both runtime versions.
method.shop_room_cost: Content open, deterministic room fixture, and first complete room render are recorded separately from opening inventory.
method.settle: Ten 250 ms updates with render before each warm window; these updates are excluded from measured first-frame and warm costs.
method.ranged_io: Source calls/bytes/seeks count production callbacks, including cache misses. Disk/controller latency and operating-system cold-cache history are not controlled.
method.quiet_window: Root confirmed all session builds, tests, browser checks and other agents idle; Firebird simulated time was paused. All 12 processes ran sequentially. This does not assert control over unrelated system activity.
method.causal_boundary: Original layout, artwork, text, cursor and cache behavior all change together. This is an overall scene comparison, not a cache-only A/B experiment.

acceptance.visual_review: Final English hover and Chinese baseline/candidate idle captures show the seven-card inventory without the accidental starter-relic tooltip.

excluded_prior_matrix.reason: The old idle point (10,35) hovered the starter Burning Blood relic and drew its tooltip over inventory. The hover-cold window also included this intermediate frame. The complete initial 12-run data and captures remain preserved; none of those merchant timings supply the accepted summary.

limitations: Three repetitions provide a bounded comparison and do not establish statistical significance for small differences.
The different resource packs and layout prevent attribution of the results to any one cache or converter change.
First-open means application cache state within this fixture, not cold operating-system storage.
Per-frame maxima are retained but no percentile distribution is inferred from aggregate counters.
Warm detail scenes make no ranged reads in either version; timing differences alone do not establish another large detail-modal speedup.
Merchant warm ranged bytes increase in the final whole-version comparison. A future per-layer I/O profile can guide grouping or retention changes while preserving the exact corrected artwork.
